THE FIRST RESOURCE FOR MATHEMATICS

## [Qu, Xiangyu](https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:qu.xiangyu)

[Purely\_subjective extended Bayesian models with Knightian unambiguity. (English) Zbl 1378.91089](https://zbmath.org/1378.91089)

[Theory Decis. 79, No. 4, 547-571 (2015)](https://zbmath.org/?q=in:350104)

Summary: This paper provides a model of belief representation in which ambiguity and unambiguity are endogenously  distinguished in purely subjective setting where objects of choices are; as usual maps from states to consequences. Specifically; I first extend the maxmin expected   utility theory and representation of beliefs such that the probabilistic beliefs over each ambiguous  event are represented by a non-degenerate interval, while the ones over each unambiguous event are represented by a number. I then consider a class of the biseparable preferences. Two representation results are achieved and can be used to identify the unambiguity in the context of the biseparable preferences. Finally a subjective definition of ambiguity is suggested. It provides a choice theoretic foundation for the Knightian distinction between ambiguity and unambiguity. get

## MSC:

Utility theory

91B06 Decision theory

91B08 Individual preferences

## Keywords:

Knightian distinction; maxmin expected utility; biseparable preference; unambiguous event
